title.value: Extending Class Group Action Attacks via Sesquilinear Pairings
Extending Class Group Action Attacks via Sesquilinear Pairings

abstract.value: We introduce a new tool for the study of isogeny-based cryptography, namely pairings which are sesquilinear (conjugate linear) with respect to the O-module structure of an elliptic curve with CM by an imaginary quadratic field O. We use these pairings to study the security of problems based on the class group action on collections oforiented ordinary or supersingular elliptic curves. This extends work of [CHM+23] and [FFP24].

We use these pairings to study the security of problems based on the class group action on collections oforiented ordinary or supersingular elliptic curves. This extends work of [CHM+23] and [FFP24].
